error_connect: We couldn't connect the store. Please try again.
welcome_desc: Hontrio builds your Google Shopping campaigns from your store's products and takes care of them every day, on autopilot.
welcome_steps: Two steps: connect your store and your Google Ads account. We'll show you the rest one by one.
store_desc: Hontrio reads your products and orders to know what sells. It doesn't change anything in your store.
edinio_desc: We'll send you to Edinio to approve access, no keys to copy. The store links by itself.
woo_tutorial_title: How do you get the API key?
woo_tut_1_desc: Usually at your-store.com/wp-admin, with an administrator account.
woo_tut_2_desc: In the left menu, WooCommerce, then Settings; the Advanced tab, REST API section.
woo_tut_3_desc: Description: Hontrio. Read is enough: Hontrio doesn't change anything in your store.
woo_tut_4_desc: Consumer Key (ck_…) and Consumer Secret (cs_…). The secret isn't shown again after you close the page.
shopify_desc: We'll send you to Shopify to approve access. Log in to the store's Shopify account first.
shopify_url_invalid: The address must look like store.myshopify.com.
store_linked: Your store is connected; products and orders are coming in the background.
sync_running: Bringing in products and orders: {{offers}} and {{orders}} so far.
sync_wait_hint: You can go on: the sync continues on its own.
google_desc: Campaigns run in your own Google Ads account and you pay Google directly. Hontrio only manages them.
google_store_account: Campaigns for {{store}} will run in the {{account}} account.
google_choose_later_one: We found {{count}} Google Ads account. Choose the store's account in Settings → Integrations.
google_choose_later_other: We found {{count}} Google Ads accounts. Choose the store's account in Settings → Integrations.
google_later: You can also connect it later, from Settings.
done_desc: The Overview shows what's left to prepare for your first campaign: Merchant Center and the purchase conversion.
